Perfect! Now I can see:
- ord_1 is in "reserved" status with 3 units of SKU-KEYB (3 × $129.00 = $387.00 total)
- ord_2 is in "draft" status with 2 units of SKU-KEYB (2 × $129.00 = $258.00 total) for Ada Byron (cus_1)
